messages.subject: I killed the builds
parts:
Not sure how -- looking into it now. Each of the merge requests were tested, but something is breaking the build. I'm hunting it down.

There is a miniscule chance that I just need to restart Jenkins, but it's more likely it's me.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: I killed the builds
parts:
Fuckity fuck fuck fuck.

It was pull request #64. Michael, test/io/mcmc_writer doesn't build. Not on Windows, not on Mac. It doesn't compile. Can you fix that?

I forgot that a side-effect of parallelization in make is that at j levels > 2, it seems to miss test errors and, in this case, compiler errors. I need to either run it again or back down our parallelization.

I'm backing out the changes now.

The documentation of my make says there is an option

       -S, --no-keep-going, --stop
            Cancel the effect of the -k option.  This is never necessary except in a recursive make where -k might be inherited from the top-level make via  MAKE‐

But it says it is only necessary if -k is set. Is it different on Windows?

Ben
